name: Mahmoud Hossam Abdelmoneim
headline: Junior Software Engineer | ECM & BPM Developer

summaries.ecm_bpm: Junior Software Engineer specializing in Enterprise Content Management (ECM), Business Process Management (BPM) and system integration. Hands-on with Doxis ECM, OpenText Content Server, IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) and FileNet, backed by Java Spring Boot and Node.js development. Delivered four ECM/BPM projects covering document management, workflow automation and system integration. B.Sc. in Computer Science with a USAID full scholarship and an exchange semester at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln.
summaries.java: Junior Software Engineer with hands-on Java and Spring Boot experience, including backend services built for OpenText ECM and IBM BAW workflows at NTI. Works with REST APIs, SQL Server, Oracle and MongoDB, and has delivered four ECM/BPM projects covering workflow automation and system integration. B.Sc. in Computer Science (GPA 3.37) with a USAID full scholarship and an exchange semester at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln.
summaries.node: Junior Software Engineer with Node.js and Express backend experience, including an e-commerce backend with MongoDB and Redis caching, alongside Java Spring Boot services and ECM/BPM workflow automation. Works with REST APIs, SQL Server, Oracle and Docker. B.Sc. in Computer Science (GPA 3.37) with a USAID full scholarship and an exchange semester at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln.
summaries.fullstack: Junior Software Engineer with full-stack project experience across ASP.NET Core with SQL Server, Node.js and Express with MongoDB and Redis, and Flutter mobile apps with REST API integration. Skills also include Angular, Java Spring Boot and Docker. B.Sc. in Computer Science (GPA 3.37) with a USAID full scholarship and an exchange semester at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln.
summaries.software: Junior Software Engineer with experience across Java Spring Boot, Node.js, ASP.NET Core and Flutter, and four ECM/BPM projects covering document management, workflow automation and system integration. Works with SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB, Redis, Git and Docker. B.Sc. in Computer Science (GPA 3.37) with a USAID full scholarship and an exchange semester at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln.
summaries.it_support: Junior Software Engineer with IT support internship experience at EGAS (hardware, software and network troubleshooting, VMware virtualization and Palo Alto firewall operations) and a Computer Science background. Skills include Linux, VMware, SQL Server, Oracle and Git. B.Sc. in Computer Science (GPA 3.37) with a USAID full scholarship and an exchange semester at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln.
